integrity: The structural iff proof and rational enumeration apply to all lengths; a dependency-free finite checker reproduces length 3–25 cases and coefficients 0–65. No independent mathematical verification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns indexed, linear binary words with exactly three ones and nonempty proper covers, not general fixed-weight or infinite words; unindexed equivalence may exist.
title: Exact quasiperiod spectra of three-marker binary words
